sermon.title: The Holy Spirit Speaks to All Mankind 10/15/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the Holy Spirit speaks to all mankind—backsliders, the faithful and the world—through the conscience, with or without preaching. From 1 Timothy 4, John 7 and John 16 he covers the seared conscience, the outpouring on all flesh, conviction of sin, righteousness and judgment, and guidance into all truth, then argues from John 3:18–21 and Romans 2 that people are condemned for evil deeds against conscience, and calls the church to get the message out.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Transcript begins at 0:01. Points to check: Pentecost tongues as “15 different languages”; 80,000 alcohol deaths and “hundreds” of marijuana deaths a year; “half of America has or has had a venereal disease”; Catholics filled with the Spirit in 1968; minister housing allowance case “going to the supreme”; homosexual activists’ “millions of dollars in propaganda” in the South. Sensitive content kept as spoken: churches calling adultery, drunkenness, drugs and homosexual acts okay are hypocrites; people condemned for evil deeds, not for unbelief; believing Jews and Judas went to hell, “a believer can go to hell”; Pentecostals of the 50s–60s “thought they were the elect people”, “phony stuff”; “America hates Jesus”; vision of heaven, hell and the judgment while watching TV.
